title: El Dorado Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Grand beachfront home in Seaside, Florida. The expansive "El Dorado" spans from 30A to the beach. Over 5,300 square feet, sleeping 24 in a prime location! Incredible porches on every level, best gulf and sunset views!
description_expanded: Description2160 East Co Hwy 30A - BEACHFRONTMAIN HOME (5 BDS, sleeps 18): 3 BUNK ROOMS, KING, KINGCARRIAGE HOUSE: (2 BDS, sleeps 6): KING, BUNKROOMA Grand Gulf-Front Estate on Scenic Highway 30AWelcome to El Dorado, a truly spectacular Gulf-front estate in Seaside, Florida, stretching from Scenic Highway 30A all the way to the dunes overlooking the emerald waters of the Gulf of Mexico. With porches and open-air living spaces on every level, this extraordinary home delivers breathtaking beachfront views from sunrise to sunset. Offered as one private rental, El Dorado includes both a main residence and a carriage house, together accommodating up to 24 guests, making it ideal for multi-generational families, reunions, or group retreats.First Floor Main House | Custom Bunk Suites & Family AmenitiesDesigned with families in mind, the first level of the main home features three custom-built bunk bedrooms, sleeping 14 guests total—a dream setup for kids and teens.Bunk Room One (Sleeps 4): Four twin beds with built-in storage throughoutBunk Room Two (Sleeps 5): Three twin beds and one full bed, sharing a beautifully finished full bathroom with a marble tub/shower combo and single vanityBunk Room Three (Sleeps 5): Three twin beds and one full bed with a private ensuite bath featuring a marble double vanity, soaker tub, and glass walk-in showerThis level also includes a laundry room, an outdoor shower, and a charming porch outfitted with two swinging daybeds, perfect for relaxing after a beach day. Fitness enthusiasts will appreciate the Peloton bike, allowing you to stay on track even while on vacation.Second Floor Main House | Dual King Primary Suites & Iconic Gulf ViewsThe second level showcases two luxurious king primary suites, each designed as a private retreat.Primary King Suite One: Sitting area with TV, dedicated desk space, and a spa-inspired ensuite featuring a soaker tub, dual marble vanities, and a glass-enclosed walk-in shower with dual rain showerheadsPrimary King Suite Two: King bed, TV, and a beautifully appointed ensuite bath with a soaker tub, dual marble vanities, and a rain showerBoth suites open onto the home’s signature beachfront porch—an expansive outdoor living space with plush seating and jaw-dropping panoramic Gulf and sunset views.Carriage House | Private Bedrooms & Independent Living SpacesConnected to the main home by an enclosed second-floor bridge, the two-story carriage house offers additional privacy and flexibility.Bedroom Six: King bedroom with private bath and Juliet balconyBedroom Seven: Bunk room with two bunk beds (four twins), private bath, and Juliet balconyThis level also includes a washer and dryer with utility sink, making extended stays easy and comfortable.Third Floor Living | Chef’s Kitchen, Dining & Gulf-View PorchesThe third level is the heart of El Dorado—perfect for gathering, entertaining, and making memories.Showstopping chef’s kitchen with three Wolf ovens, a six-burner gas range, and ample space for large-scale meal preparationDining area featuring a large table seating 10 plus a bistro table for twoLiving room with a large mounted TV, Gulf views, and direct access to an expansive open-air porchThe beachfront porch on this level offers outdoor lounge seating, dining for eight, and some of the most impressive Gulf and sunset views in Seaside. A convenient half bath is also located on this floor.Elevated Coastal Living in the Heart of SeasideWith its unparalleled beachfront location, multiple living zones, and thoughtful design across both the main home and carriage house, El Dorado is a rare offering in Seaside, Florida. From kids’ bunk rooms to luxurious primary suites and sweeping Gulf-front porches, this estate delivers an unforgettable coastal experience for large families and groups seeking space, comfort, and iconic 30A views.* Guests have access to the 2-car garage. The garage holds 2 small/mid-size vehicles only. Due to the proximity to the neighboring home, there is no parking on the driveway between the homes. Overflow parking will need to be used for larger vehicles or more than 2 mid-size vehicles.* 5 Night minimum for Spring, Spring Break, and Summer 2026. Sat to Sat 7 night minimum for Summer 2027. 3 Nights Fall, 2 Nights Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent & sign registration.FEATURES5,328 square feet of expansive Gulf-front living across the main house and carriage houseJust 187 feet (approximately a 1-minute walk) to private beach accessExclusive Seaside residential beach access at West Ruskin Pavilion, featuring the largest stretch of private beaches on 30AChef’s kitchen equipped with a six-burner Wolf gas range, double oven, and pot-filler water faucetAdditional Wolf oven, providing a total of three ovens—ideal for large gatherings and family mealsAccess to Seaside’s premier amenities, including 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fully equipped fitness centerWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two rental bikes, available for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized guest service throughout your stay, with thoughtful starter amenities providedGolf cart policy: Golf carts are considered vehicles; golf carts are prohibited for non-homeowners visiting Seaside. Special circumstances or medical needs require an approved golf cart permitNo pets allowedSTR24-000893
